text:
Mia S.: quick heads-up — Evergreen Retail POC is paused. CISO says they need exec sign-off by EOD on network approach and a pricing concession. They're blocked on SSO (SAML/SCIM) + egress estimate. @Harper G. can you advise?
Devin R.: have we received their SSO metadata yet? also need sustained throughput numbers — they mentioned 600 rps @ ~512 tokens. will size dedicated config once we confirm.
Harper G.: I can take the exec touchpoint. Finance wants committed terms before we offer any discount. what’s the minimum we can promise without legal?
Sanjay K.: infra note: 600 rps sustained at 512 tokens is non-trivial. a 4-GPU dedicated pool (A10-class) with aggressive batching looks feasible but predictability depends on prefix reuse. peering required for private endpoints; otherwise we expose a VPC endpoint. egress estimate depends on token count — rough calc: 300M tokens/month -> ~$8k egress. need actual logs.
Li Chen: Security: SAML + SCIM supported. We need to respond to their questionnaire items Q3 (encryption at rest) and Q7 (penetration testing cadence). SOC2 + current pen test summary available. see: https://redwood.internal/sec/evergreen-sq
Mia S.: they just uploaded the metadata and the completed questionnaire (attached). also asked about 24/7 support SLA during POC and on-call escalation path.
Devin R.: tiling a config for them — draft autoscale snippet below (for discussion):
```yaml
dedicated_pool:
  gpus: 4
  instance_type: a10x
  autoscale:
    min: 2
    max: 8
    target_utilization: 0.65
    burst: true
```
Devin R.: if they accept model fallback (smaller 7B variant) for non-critical workloads, cost and latency profile improves a lot.
deploy-bot: dedicated-request #REQ-452 created for Evergreen Retail (owner: Harper G.).
Harper G.: proposed plan
1) I schedule exec sync w/ customer today (2pm PT).
2) Devin to finalize perf/cost numbers by 12:30pm.
3) Li to produce answers for Q3/Q7 and attestation doc by 3pm.
4) Sanjay to confirm peering timeline and optional private endpoint by EOD.
Mia S.: I’ll prep a one-pager for their execs and cc VP Sales if discount >20% is needed. @Harper G. what’s the discount floor we should expect?
Harper G.: discount floor without exec/legal approval is 20% for a 12mo commit. 30% requires legal signoff + exec approval. I’ll start the escalation if they push.
Sanjay K.: peering ETA: ~48 hours after customer network provides CIDR + test account. private endpoint via ephemeral VPN can be staged in ~24 hours but requires their firewall rules.
Li Chen: pen-test window ~2-3 weeks if they request vendor testing; we can provide our latest report & attestation within 24 hours. encryption at rest: AES-256 w/ KMS-managed keys, customer-managed key options available.
Mia S.: customer is asking for go/no-go tomorrow AM. flagging: escalate to VP Sales if we don’t have final pricing + security attestation by 5pm PT. :eyes:
Harper G.: noted. I’ll ping legal now and loop VP Sales if needed.
Mia S.: thanks team — please post final artifacts in this thread (pricing calc, perf numbers, security attestation).
